claugetdevohmycode/claude-mods

The scale, then the diet: and the diet only where the scale says it pays. Each model request inside a turn streams through one hook, whose stop chunk carries the four token counters and the model that answered, so the journal has a line per step, the main loop's and every subagent's apart, and names the cache misses where they happen. /clauget opens the report: the window and the cost, the bill of the prefix by provider with how often each provider's tools were called, the break-even of deferring, the instruction files, and every lever with what it saved and what it cost. Out of the box the mod measures and changes nothing. /clauget on, off or strict turns the levers on from the next session: a policy on the prefix decided once and never moved mid-session, tool results cut to the shape of their fat and filed whole so one Read undoes a cut, a small-prefix explorer agent, a lighter transcript for the compaction, economy tiers that tighten with the plan window, a forecast of when it fills, and prompts deferred to its reset. Each lever was measured on a real session; the ones that lost were closed and are named in the README. Nothing the mod writes reaches the model unless a lever puts it there, and then it is counted in the mod's own column.

messagedevohmycode/claude-mods

What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context. A peer's delivery is written to the mailbox under your home directory, listed in the Message tab beside the thread it belongs to, and announced in one line: and the session's transcript does not grow by a byte. The thread draws each message whole, wrapped to the column it has, with a Show more under the long ones that opens the rest in place: reading what was held has to be free, or holding it saved nothing. You read it and decide: Hand to Claude puts it in the context and starts a turn, which is the only moment it costs anything, or the field at the bottom answers it, calling SendMessage in the session's own loop so that no model turn is started to write three words. The left column lists the sessions running on this machine, read from the engine's own register: the name each goes by: the one /rename sets, and the one SendMessage takes: with the folder it works in and whether it is busy, this session named at the head of it and a refresh button (r) for the moment you rename one next door; the footer counts what was sent without a turn, what is held, and the bytes kept out of the transcript, three figures in two units and no total over them. It is the cockpit's fifth tab where a cockpit is seated, and opens a pane of its own where none is. /message opens it, /message hand hands everything held over at once, /message hold turns the holding off for the session, and /message who answers with the register of sessions this one can write to.

Die Liste geht je Projekt in die nächste Sitzung mit (offen.md, offen.json für claude-web), Entscheidungen landen mit Gründen in einem Tagesverlauf. /offen zeigt und bedient alles (auch /offen <Nr> <Text> als freie Antwort, Kurzformen /erledigt <Nr> und /weg <Nr>, /offen alle weg, /offen klären [alle]: „alle“ übernimmt auch Punkte anderer Sitzungen), /zusammenfassung fasst die Sitzung zusammen. /offen übergabe lässt das Hauptmodell eine Übergabe für die nächste Sitzung schreiben (Archiv uebergaben/, Übersicht index.md) und leert danach den Verlauf per /clear (mit „nur“ ohne); die nächste neue Unterhaltung bekommt sie mit der ersten Nachricht, ohne wartende Übergabe den Überblick der letzten Sitzung. /offen übergaben listet das Archiv, /offen übergabe <Nr> zeigt eine.
